subject: general
question: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan was launched by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee launched the **Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA)** in 2001.
 
• It aimed at the universalization of elementary education **by providing free and compulsory education** to children between the ages of 6 to 14 years.
 
• The SSA was one of the largest education initiatives undertaken by the Indian government.
 
• It focused on bridging gender and social category gaps in education at the elementary level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Right to Education (RTE) Act**

 
 
• The Right to Education Act was enacted on August 4, 2009, and came into effect on April 1, 2010.
 
• It mandates free and compulsory education for children between the ages of 6 and 14 years under Article 21A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• RTE emphasizes the importance of quality education and the need to eliminate discrimination in schools.
 
• The act also outlines the minimum norms and standards for schools to ensure proper infrastructure and learning environments.
 
 
 
• **Mid-Day Meal Scheme**
 
 
• Launched on August 15, 1995, the Mid-Day Meal Scheme aims to enhance enrollment, retention, and attendance of children in schools.
 
• It provides free lunches to students in primary and upper primary classes in government and government-aided schools.
 
• The scheme has had a significant impact on improving the nutritional status of children and encouraging regular attendance.
 
• This initiative is an important step towards ensuring that children from underprivileged backgrounds receive at least one nutritious meal a day.
 
 
 
• **National Programme for Education of Girls at Elementary Level (NPEGEL)**
 
 
• NPEGEL is a component of SSA that focuses on reducing the gender gap in education.
 
• It targets girls in educationally backward blocks and provides additional support to ensure their enrollment, retention, and completion of elementary education.
 
• The program includes community mobilization, provision of incentives, and creating girl-friendly learning environments.
 
• NPEGEL plays a crucial role in promoting gender equality and empowering girls through education.
 
 
 
• **Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV)**
 
 
• Launched in 2004, KGBV is a scheme under SSA that establishes residential schools for girls from disadvantaged groups.
 
• It aims to provide quality education to girls from marginalized communities, especially in rural areas.
 
• KGBV focuses on the holistic development of girls, including academic, social, and vocational skills.
 
• The scheme has been instrumental in increasing the enrollment and retention of girls in schools.
